title: Why You Should Go for a 'Color Walk'
paragraphs: Do you want an easy way to relax? Then you can try a "color walk." It is a popular trend on social media, especially on TikTok.

A color walk is very simple. First, you choose a color, like red, yellow or blue. Then, you go outside for a walk. While you walk, you look for things that are that color. For example, if you choose red, you may see a red sign, a red car or a red flower.
Some people do a color walk every day. They choose a different color for each day of the week. For example, they may choose red on Monday and orange on Tuesday.

Why is a color walk good for you? People say that it can help you live in the present. When you look for one color, you do not think so much about your problems. Prerna Menon, a psychotherapist, says that a color walk makes your mind work in a different way from a normal walk. Instead of walking on autopilot, you pay attention to the things around you. This may help you feel calm.
A color walk is also a type of exercise, because you are walking. So, it is good for your body too. It may also help people who want to walk more steps every day.
However, there are not many scientific studies about color walks. Most of the information comes from experts' opinions and people's own experiences.
Still, a color walk is free and easy. Why not try it?
